owner: Inner Cosmos Psychology Capability Working Group

title.zh-CN: 从三个位置看这段关系
title.en-SG: See the relationship from three seats

description.zh-CN: 在同一件事里轮流坐到自己、对方和旁观者的位置，练习视角切换，不替对方下结论。
description.en-SG: Take turns in your seat, the other person's seat and an observer's seat to practise perspective-taking, without deciding what they think.

limitations.zh-CN: 视角切换是反思练习，不读心、不判断对方动机，也不替代伴侣咨询或家庭治疗；证据出处与文案待心理专家复核（CP-60A 双专家门禁）。
limitations.en-SG: Perspective-taking here is a reflection exercise: it does not read minds, judge the other person's motives, or replace couples or family counselling. Evidence citations and wording await psychology expert review (CP-60A dual-expert gate).
